_comment: The common real-world case: a homeserver with presence turned off (Synapse's default `use_presence: false`, and matrix.org itself). EVERY /presence call is refused with 403 M_FORBIDDEN. The plugin must degrade to a roster-only run — persons still emitted, zero presence observations, a clear note on stderr, exit code 0 — rather than failing.
